/* emailMapper.getEmailList */ SELECT A.EMAIL_ID ,A.SUBJECT ,A.CONTENT ,A.SEND_DATE ,A.STATUS ,A.STATUS_NAME ,A.FRST_REGISTER_ID ,A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ,USER_NAME AS USER_NAME FROM ( SELECT EMAIL_ID ,SUBJECT ,CONTENT ,SEND_DATE ,STATUS ,OCC.LABEL AS STATUS_NAME ,FRST_REGISTER_ID ,DATE_FORMAT(OE.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'%Y%m%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ,OM.USER_NAME FROM OP_EMAIL OE INNER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE OCC ON OE.STATUS = OCC.ID AND OCC.CODE_TYPE = 'EMAIL_STATUS' LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_MANAGER OM ON OE.FRST_REGISTER_ID = OM.USER_ID
ORDER BY EMAIL_ID DESC )A

/* emailMapper.sendUserList */ SELECT A.EMAIL_ID ,USER_NAME AS USER_NAME ,EMAIL AS EMAIL
FROM ( SELECT #{emailId} AS EMAIL_ID ,OU.USER_NAME ,OU.EMAIL FROM OP_USER_ROLE OUR INNER JOIN OP_MANAGER OU ON OUR.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND OU.EMAIL IS NOT NULL AND OU.STATUS_CODE = '9' AND OUR.AUTHORITY IN ( SELECT AUTHORITY FROM OP_EMAIL_DETAIL WHERE EMAIL_ID = #{emailId} ) )A

SELECT OE.EMAIL_ID ,OE.SUBJECT ,OE.CONTENT ,OE.SEND_DATE ,OE.AUTH_TARGET ,OE.STATUS ,OCC.LABEL AS STATUS_NAME FROM OP_EMAIL OE INNER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE OCC ON OE.STATUS = OCC.ID AND OCC.CODE_TYPE = 'EMAIL_STATUS' WHERE EMAIL_ID = #{emailId}
SELECT OED.EMAIL_ID ,OED.AUTHORITY ,O.ROLE_NAME FROM OP_EMAIL_DETAIL OED INNER JOIN OP_ROLE O ON OED.AUTHORITY = O.AUTHORITY WHERE EMAIL_ID = #{emailId}
SELECT EMAIL_FILE_ID ,EMAIL_ID ,FILE_NAME ,ORG_FILE_NAME ,FILE_TY FROM OP_EMAIL_FILE WHERE EMAIL_ID = #{emailId}

SELECT A.USER_ID ,user_name AS USER_NAME ,email AS EMAIL FROM ( SELECT USER_ID ,user_name ,email FROM OP_USER WHERE STATUS_CODE = 9 AND EMAIL IS NOT NULL AND EMAIL != '' AND USER_NAME IS NOT NULL AND USER_NAME != '' AND USER_NAME = #{userName} ) A

SELECT A.EMAIL_ID ,USER_NAME AS USER_NAME ,EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM ( SELECT #{emailId} AS EMAIL_ID ,USER_NAME ,EMAIL FROM OP_SELLER WHERE STATUS_CODE = 2 AND ITEM_APPROVAL_TYPE = 1 AND EMAIL IS NOT NULL AND EMAIL != '' AND USER_NAME IS NOT NULL AND USER_NAME != '' ) A
